author: Michael Larabel
description: While the GIMP 3.2 release is expected out soon, GIMP 3.0.8 is available tonight as what could end up being the last set of bug fixes for GIMP 3.0...
title: GIMP 3.0.8 Released In Advance Of GIMP 3.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following yesterday's release of Wine 11.1 for kicking off the new post-11.0 development cycle, Wine-Staging 11.1 is now available for this experimental/testing version of Wine that present is around 254 patches over the upstream Wine state...
title: Wine-Staging 11.1 Adds Patches For Enabling Recent Adobe Photoshop Versions On Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Arch Linux powered CachyOS distribution is out with its first new ISO release of 2026. This Linux distribution continues to be quite popular with Linux gamers, enthusiasts craving peak performance, and others for wanting to enjoy a polished Arch Linux desktop experience...
title: CachyOS Starts 2026 By Switching To Plasma Login Manager & Live ISO Using Wayland

author: Michael Larabel
description: There's yet another new Linux file-system on the block: DAXFS has been announced as a new read-only open-source file-system...
title: DAXFS Proposed As Newest Linux File-System

author: Michael Larabel
description: DXVK-NVAPI 0.9.1 is out today as this NVIDIA NVAPI implementation that is used by Valve's Steam Play (Proton) with DXVK and VKD3D-Proton. This is the important piece of the Steam Play puzzle to allow for NVIDIA DLSS, NVIDIA Reflex, PhysX, and other features for Windows games running on Linux...
title: DXVK-NVAPI 0.9.1 Released With New Override & Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the upcoming Linux 6.20~7.0 kernel cycle it looks like the time slice extension work could finally been merged, which has seen various attempts over the past decade. Time slice extension for the Linux kernel implemented using Restartable Sequences "RSEQ" allows user-space processes to request a temporary, opportunistic extension of their CPU time slice without being preempted...
title: A Decade In The Making, Time Slice Extension Could Be Merged For Linux 7.0

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to AMD releasing the Ryzen AI Software 1.7 release on Friday, they also published a new version of their MLIR-AIE compiler toolchain for targeting AMD Ryzen AI NPU devices with this LLVM-based MLIR-focused stack...
title: AMD Releases MLIR-AIE 1.2 Compiler Toolchain For Targeting Ryzen AI NPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged on Friday as part of this week's DRM kernel graphics driver fixes for the week is addressing a regression affecting many different users with the Linux 6.19 development kernel...
title: AMDGPU Driver Reverts Code For A Number Of Regressions On Linux 6.19

author: Michael Larabel
description: Newlle as a virtual AI assistant for the GNOME desktop with API integration for Google Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, and also local LLMs is out with a new release. Newelle has been steadily expanding its AI integration and capabilities and with the new Newelle 1.2 are yet more capabilities for those wanting AI on the GNOME desktop...
title: GNOME's AI Assistant Newelle Adds Llama.cpp Support, Command Execution Tool

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new driver in the Linux 6.19 kernel is the ASUS Armoury driver for supporting additional functionality with the ROG Ally gaming handhelds and other ASUS ROG gaming hardware like their laptops. The ASUS Armoury driver builds off the existing ASUS WMI driver but provides some design improvements to make it better than handling it within the existing driver. There is support for adjusting the APU-allocated memory, Intel core count control for P and E cores, FHD and UHD mode switching for display panels, and other features typically only exposed via the system BIOS...
title: ASUS Armoury Driver For Linux 6.19 Picks Up Support For More ASUS Laptops

author: Michael Larabel
description: KDE Plasma 6.6 feature development work continues winding down while Plasma 6.7 has begun seeing more feature work. This week also saw at least nine different crash fixes affecting Plasma/KWin...
title: KDE Plasma Saw At Least 9 Crash Fixes This Week
